verdict.rationale: Attio's REST API supports filtering/sorting to narrow record sets and has SQL query access, and its API/MCP integration could enable scripted bulk updates, but there is no explicit documentation of a bulk-update/bulk-create/bulk-delete endpoint or batch operation limits for AI-driven mass edits. missing for 10: explicit bulk write/update API endpoints, documented batch size limits, and evidence of AI agents performing bulk operations across many records at once.
